Add a `skill` parameter in `[0,1]` to the AI controller layer: the share of decisions per turn that follow the best AI versus a random legal action. `1.0` decides exactly as before, `0.0` plays `random_action`, and every roll draws on the caller's seeded RNG, so seeded runs reproduce and the knob survives AI updates and new sets. Wire it through self-play matches (`SeatController`), the arena referee (per-entrant flags), the ladder-bot seat (`BotStrength.skill`), and the strengths table; measure the skill-to-Elo curve in arena games and ship it as the `expected_elo_for_skill` function plus the `SKILL_ELO_TABLE` the server reads, with a new R747000 ruling amending R1452.

## Goal

Ladder bots with higher target ratings get measurably stronger decks. Random bot decks bias generation toward high in-deck win-rate cards from the compiled-in `win_rates.json` table, scaled by the bot's target strength; borrowed human decklists are ranked by observed per-list performance with a sample-threshold fallback to today's random legal lists. The soft gate (`gated_sets`) and shadow-ban (`banned`) plumbing in the deck builder keeps working exactly as now.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | New `AiWinRate` struct and `AI_WIN_RATE` const (threshold, boost, floor) |
| `crates/ai/src/deck.rs` | change | New `strength` field on `AiDeckOptions`, new `win_rate_weight` helper, one multiplier in the weight closure |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs` | change | Two tests proving strength-1 decks beat strength-0 decks and strength-0 reproduces today's decks |
| `crates/server/src/actor/engine.rs` | change | New `deal_random_deck_with_strength` and `deal_random_deck_excluding_with_strength`; old fns delegate at 0.0 |
| `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs` | change | New `bot_target_strength` and `ranked_human_bo1_decklists`; `draw_decks`/`draw_trio` take strength |
